system.notes:
Internal Matrix host for Renraku Arcology Residential Block B — housing, environmental controls, and personal communications for 40,000 residents. The SN controls HVAC, door locks, and elevator systems for six towers.

Notable data: Resident communications (monitored), physical access logs for all doors, environmental override codes. Renraku treats any intrusion as a threat against the Arcology itself.

nodes.name: System Access Node
nodes.description: Internal-only gateway. Resident access requires Renraku residential SIN. No public access pathway exists — the SAN is not listed on any external directory.

nodes.name: I/O Port
nodes.description: Building management console. Located in the Arcology's secure network operations centre, sublevel 3. Physical access requires Renraku security clearance level 4.

nodes.name: Sub-Processing Unit
nodes.description: Central routing for resident data, environmental requests, and security event processing.

nodes.name: Data Store
nodes.description: Resident files, physical access logs (every door, every elevator, every moment), and monitored communication archives. A complete record of 40,000 people's movements.

nodes.name: Slave Node — Environmental
nodes.description: Controls HVAC, temperature, air filtration, and utilities for all six residential towers. Compromising this node means control over the environment of 40,000 people.

nodes.name: Slave Node — Access Control
nodes.description: Controls all electronic door locks, elevator access, and physical security cameras throughout Block B. Every mag-lock in the Arcology runs through here.

nodes.name: Central Processing Unit
nodes.description: Renraku Arcology Security master node. Direct link to Arcology Command. Any breach here triggers building-wide lockdown protocols automatically.

ioPorts.name: Network Operations Centre Console
ioPorts.physicalLocation: Arcology NOC, Sublevel 3. Accessible only via Renraku Security escort. Biometric + passcode + security clearance level 4 required. Staffed 24/7 by Renraku sysops.

triggerSteps.label: TS 1
triggerSteps.description: Alert (Passive) and Encryption (Passive) activate simultaneously. Resident data traffic encrypted mid-stream. Renraku NOC alerted instantly — this is a monitored residential system and intrusion is treated as a physical threat to residents.

triggerSteps.label: TS 2
triggerSteps.description: Authenticator launches. All active sessions re-challenged. Renraku residential SINs are not easily forged — the Arcology issues them internally and validates against a biometric registry.

triggerSteps.label: TS 3
triggerSteps.description: Tracker deploys and feeds live data to the duty security commander. Building-wide physical alert declared. Arcology Security moving to jackpoint locations throughout Block B.

triggerSteps.label: TS 4
triggerSteps.description: Gemini deploys — two instances, each pursuing the intruder in separate nodes. They coordinate; if the decker moves to evade one, the other is already there. Overload attacks, Moderate damage.

triggerSteps.label: TS 5
triggerSteps.description: Hydra launches. Multi-instance attack — one head per node the decker has accessed. Fighting your way out of the Arcology's Matrix is like fighting your way through the building — every corridor covered.

triggerSteps.label: TS 6
triggerSteps.description: SN-E environmental lockdown: ventilation in Block B restricted, elevator movement suspended except for Security use. 40,000 residents are now aware something is wrong. SN-A locks all non-emergency exits.

triggerSteps.label: TS 7
triggerSteps.description: Killer IC deploys. This is not a warning — Renraku Arcology Security has authorised lethal Matrix countermeasures. VR-Hot deckers are now at risk of Physical damage on every exchange.

triggerSteps.label: TS 8
triggerSteps.description: Full Arcology Security alert. All of Block B physically locked down. Physical arrest teams moving through every floor. The decker has minutes before their jackpoint is reached.

triggerSteps.label: TS 9
triggerSteps.description: Convergence. Arcology Command assumes direct control of the subnet. GOD response inbound. Inside the Arcology, there is nowhere to run. Renraku does not call the police — they handle this themselves.
